title: Boundary Agent: policy enforcer with drift detection and signed audit bundles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Boundary Agent that continuously monitors cluster and account-level configuration for geo-residency and retention rules, enforces policy-as-code decisions, performs safe remediation, and emits signed audit bundles for compliance evidence. The agent targets Dedicated and Private deployments where regulatory residency + retention constraints are enforced. It should support: 1) declarative policies (Rego-like) compiled to executable checks, 2) a lightweight controller to detect config drift vs. declared policy, 3) remediation modes (alert-only, suggested-change PR, direct-reconcile with audit trail), and 4) a signed evidence bundling pipeline (deterministic JSON + envelope signed by customer KMS/HSM) delivered to customer-controlled storage or the Redwood evidence service.
acceptance_criteria: Agent runs in Dedicated and Private clusters and loads repo-backed policy definitions
Drift detector identifies mismatches between declared residency/retention policy and actual resource config with <60s detection for config changes
Remediation modes implemented: Alert, PR (GitOps-style), and Auto-reconcile (toggleable per-org/namespace)
Evidence bundles include: snapshot of violating resources, policy version, remediation action, timeline, and a KMS-signed envelope
Evidence export supports S3-compatible endpoints and Redwood Secure Evidence Store; retention and access logs recorded
End-to-end tests demonstrating a simulated cross-region data-store misconfigured for retention and successful detection + evidence export
implementation_plan: Design policy schema for residency and retention, include resource selectors and severity annotations
Prototype a policy compiler that emits lightweight checks and a webhook-based admission hook for create/update events
Build a drift detector reconciler that periodically snapshots effective config and compares to desired state, with rate-limited alerts
Implement remediation engine with three safe modes; ensure RBAC gate for Auto-reconcile
Create evidence bundler: canonicalize JSON payload, include policy hash and agent version, sign with customer KMS or Redwood key when permitted
Integrate with Console: per-org policy view, recent drift incidents, evidence download links, and signed audit viewer
Add telemetry: per-policy violation counts, time-to-detect, time-to-remediate, and evidence export success/failure
progress_updates: 2026-03-05: Spike completed on policy schema and canonical evidence format; minimal fields defined
2026-03-08: Prototype compiler outputs Rego-compatible checks and a stub webhook; POC detects simulated retention misconfig
2026-03-11: Reconciler loop implemented (snapshot diff) with basic alerting via Slack channel #compliance-alerts
2026-03-14: Evidence bundler v0 writes unsigned bundles to local object store; next step KMS signing integration
decision_log: Adopt declarative policy-as-code with a thin compiler rather than embedding full Rego runtime to reduce runtime dependencies
Default remediation mode for new customers will be PR-only to align with platform trust-building
Evidence bundles will be canonical JSON plus Base64 signature; support both customer KMS and Redwood signing for trial customers
tests: Unit tests for policy compiler with 100+ sample policies including edge cases for retention 0, indefinite retention, and multi-region selectors
Integration test: create a storage resource in wrong region -> detect within 60s -> create suggested PR with correct region
E2E test for evidence bundle signature verification using test KMS key and verification tool
Chaos test: simulated agent crash and recovery retains last-known state and resumes drift detection without duplicate evidence exports
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal Redwood Dedicated clusters only, remediation mode = Alert-only
Beta: invited customers on Dedicated with PR-mode enabled; collect feedback and adjust policy schema
GA: wide release with Auto-reconcile behind per-org feature flag and Console controls; provide migration guide
Backout: per-org toggle to disable agent + retain existing evidence; manual rollback runbook documented
risks: Risk of false positives impacting customer workflows; mitigation: start in PR-mode and provide easy suppressions
Signing key management increases surface area; mitigation: offer customer-managed KMS integration and hardened key usage patterns
Large-scale evidence export could be expensive and flood storage; mitigation: sampling policy, compression, and retention policies configurable
Auto-reconcile could cause unintended changes in complex infra; mitigation: strict RBAC approval for Auto mode and dry-run logs
